facts.fact: The Ministry of Information, Communication and Information Technology issued the National ICT Policy 2023, dated June 2023 with a ministerial foreword, as successor to the 2016 policy; the text states no adoption date or act, so this is recorded as complete and awaiting adoption.
The full text of the policy is held as posted on the ministry's website (mawasiliano.go.tz), cover dated June 2023.
The policy states no end year; it says it will be evaluated after five years of implementation, and its aspirations run to 2025.
The policy contains no costed or dated action plan; it says each stakeholder is to develop a strategic implementation plan and that the implementation strategy follows the policy.

The policy sets out no progress report against its own targets; it says the ministry will design a monitoring and evaluation system with KPIs after the implementation interventions are formulated, and evaluate after five years.
The policy gives the ministry responsible for ICT overall direction and responsibility for monitoring and evaluation, and provides for a Presidential National ICT Steering Committee.

The policy ties no budget line to its implementation; it only calls on all stakeholders to lift their ICT development budget to a minimum of 9% of total budget, and names development partners for resource mobilisation.
